posts.en:
deepseek-vision#plugins/dsh-plugin-deepseek-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-deb56b353690fcab486f.html
